name: Wellable
summary: Wellable runs employee wellness challenges from a library of more than 40 turnkey challenges, with a mobile app, wearable integrations and real-time participation insights. Essentials and Pro are each listed at $625 a month with a $1.25 per-user figure beside the price. Enterprise is quoted on request.

facts.text: The challenges page says Wellable's Challenge Library offers over 40 turnkey challenges that employers can set up with help from a customer success manager.
The page names challenges including Move More, Mental Health Matters, Nutrition Ambition, Step It Up, Wealth and Hydrate for Health.
The page says real-time insights give clear visibility into participation and results, and that progress can be tracked during a challenge.
The page says employees can track progress in a native mobile app and through integrations for wearables and fitness apps.
The pricing page lists Essentials and Pro at $625 a month each, with $1.25 per user shown beside each price. Enterprise has no listed price and requires a custom quote.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.unit: per month, with $1.25 per user shown beside the price
plans.notes: Billed monthly by default, according to the pricing FAQ. The page does not expand the per-user abbreviation.

plans.name: Pro
plans.unit: per month, with $1.25 per user shown beside the price
plans.notes: Same listed price and per-user figure as Essentials. The page does not show what Pro adds.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The page says a custom quote is needed for the program.

hiddenCosts: The FAQ says the first invoice includes a one-time implementation fee. The amount is not stated.
The standard contract term is one year, with an option to renew annually.
